title: a16z Podcast: The Business of Healthcare

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Starbucks supposedly spends more on healthcare than it does on coffee beans.
reader_summary.overview: Starbucks supposedly spends more on healthcare than it does on coffee beans. And 20 years ago, says Rajeev Singh, CEO of Accolade, healthcare was 10% of GDP; today it’s 19% -- that's nearly one-fifths of our gross domestic product. So what tools do we have to address the high costs of health care, especially as stakeholders increasingly look for value-based care?

key_points.text: What are the macro trends driving innovations in the business of healthcare?
And what will define the success of companies in this space?
